topic: Ten Red Flags Before Buying a Commercial Property
caption:
Before you sign on the dotted line in Chester County or Montgomery County, pause and run a focused pre‑purchase checklist. Lesson 46 outlines ten red flags commercial investors, landlords, building owners, and business owners should identify during due diligence. Key areas include deferred structural maintenance, environmental uncertainty, title or easement problems, zoning mismatches, tenant stability, and hidden expense traps like unrecorded utilities, accessibility upgrades, insurance, and tax reassessments. Use inspections, title review, environmental screening, and local permit checks to reduce risk. This lesson helps you spot issues early so you can adjust your offer or walk away. It does not replace professional inspections, lender requirements, or individualized tax and legal counsel. Want a printable checklist or a property review for Chester or Montgomery?
